data.one_liner: Extracts dates in various formats from raw strings.
data.what_it_does: Parses strings to extract dates using flexible formats, supporting digit-only dates, ISO 8601 timestamps, and alphanumeric dates in multiple languages. It allows configuring custom splitters and month localizations.
use_when: You need to parse unstructured user input containing dates.
You are dealing with mixed date formats across different languages.
avoid_when: You only need to parse strict, standardized date formats where DateTime.parse is sufficient.
strengths: Supports multiple languages and custom month localizations.
Handles flexible date formats and splitters out of the box.
Good performance with cached regular expressions and lookup tables.
weaknesses: Limited built-in month name languages by default (English, Ukrainian, Russian).
Incomplete or non-existent dates evaluate their DateTime getter to null.
